evaluation_corrections.fit_scope: outer fold k: fit on the three folds other than k and (k+1)%5 (the old run fitted on four folds). Standardizers, L-SML weights and groups come from the fit folds only.
evaluation_corrections.same_model_calibration: the fitted bundle of outer fold k scores the calibration fold (k+1)%5 and the evaluation fold k; scores stored write-once per (method, outer_fold, role, answer) with a model_id shared by both roles (ssl-pseudolabel-residual-v1/scripts/experiments/calfix_common.ScoreBundle). The old run calibrated from out-of-fold scores of other models (cvf_v2/scoring.py prmscores with rosters=[]), some fitted on the evaluated fold's telemetry.
evaluation_corrections.panels_and_metrics: identical evaluator and panels as results/family_tail_calfix_v1 (ssl-pseudolabel-residual-v1/scripts/experiments/calfix_evaluate.py): P1 q80 of pooled PB+PRMB calibration scores (primary, label-free), P1b q80 of the calibration fold's PRMB scores (label-free sensitivity), P2 calibration-label-selected quantile (separate label-using panel). PRMScore replayed through the official evaluator port; paired source-group bootstrap 20,000 draws recomputing PRMScore from decisions; Holm over the primary family below.
evaluation_corrections.normalization: all arms answer-z; 'ct7' = frozen CT7 step scores answer-z; 'ct7_raw' keeps the historical scale (the old run's 'ct7' row) for the before/after bridge.
evaluation_corrections.naming: 'readout_then_equal_ct7views' is the old 'ct7_top10_equal7': Top10 per stream over that stream's valid tokens, per-view answer standardization, equal mean. It is NOT the original CT7 (whose seventh view is a pooled step-level z-test); it is model-free.

label_free: all standardizers, weights, groups, tail marks
label_using: P2 threshold selection on calibration-fold labels
earlier development choices: the seven CT7 streams and their orientation, step-0 despike, Top10 readout, the mark fractions (all selected on these data before this stage)
access_statement.retrospective: CT7 itself was developed on these data over many steps; it is a reference, not an unbiased estimate of transfer.

implementation_notes.readout: the Top-k step readout is recomputed with a direct top-k mean (identical to spectral_utils.ct7_token_streams.masked_step_top10, whose unused calibrated-z branch is skipped); equality is asserted on 300 answers before scoring.
implementation_notes.masks: fusion-before-readout arms read out over tokens valid in ALL seven streams (as in the old run); the historical 'readout_then_equal_ct7views' uses each stream's own valid tokens. The matched order-of-operations pair uses the all-valid mask on both sides.
implementation_notes.token_sample: the donor standardizer and every L-SML fit use deterministic_token_sample: 60,000 tokens, allocated to answers in proportion to their length (long answers contribute more tokens), evenly spaced within answer. Not changed.

tail_marks.historical: per answer and stream: 1 on the top-k all-valid tokens (stable argsort; ties and constant streams resolved by token position), centred over the answer's all-valid tokens; k = ceil(0.2*n) (top20pct) or min(30|10, n)
tail_marks.tie_aware: top20pct with the boundary ties sharing the remaining mass (a constant stream carries no mark); declared as the token candidate 'tailtie20'
tail_marks.degeneracy: constant-stream, boundary-tie and n<k rates are reported per mark before any mechanism is inferred

candidate_and_controls.tailtie20_lsml_r10: tie-aware top20pct marks, weights applied to continuous streams, Top10
candidate_and_controls.tailtie20_partition_equal_r10: equal weight per group discovered by that fit, equal within group
candidate_and_controls.tailtie20_votes_r10: the same weights applied to the uncentred tie-aware marks

order_of_operations_matched.tokfuse_then_readout_equal_r10: = equal_r10 (same answer-local axis, donor standardizer, all-valid mask, despike, k=10)
order_of_operations_matched.readout_then_equal_matched_r10: Top10 per stream of the SAME standardized streams over the SAME all-valid mask, then equal mean

primary_contrasts_P1_prmscore_holm6: learning object: tie-aware tail vs covariance
candidate vs its learned groups with equal weights
